raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In `python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_verify.py`, compact ragged verify (`SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=compact`) runs the target model on only `verify_len` rows per request. The rest of the block is filled with padding: candidate id `0` and all-zero logits.

Every accept kernel (greedy, chain sampling, block verification, blockwise rejection) still scans the whole padded block and caps the accepted count afterwards. So `cap_trim_lens`, the count of drafts the target would have accepted past the cutoff, gets inflated in three ways:
- The in-graph epilogue (`DsparkVerifyEpilogue.__call__`) compared padding id `0` against the argmax of a zero row, which is also `0`, so the whole padding tail was counted.
- That same comparison missed real accepts of the first draft past the cutoff.
- Even with real drafts as candidates, a draft whose token id is `0`, or a sampled draft against a uniform padding row, matched rows the target never scored.

This corrupts `block_accept_lens` / `spec_num_block_accept_tokens` (API `meta_info`) and the block-accept estimate recorder. Generated output is unaffected, because `cap_trim_lens` never feeds `commit_lens`, `new_seq_lens` or the bonus token.

## Modifications

- `build_accept_outs` takes a new `scored_lens` argument: the number of target rows per request that carry real logits. Row `j` verifies draft `j + 1`, so `cap_trim_lens` is bounded by `scored_lens − correct_len` (at most 1 in compact mode). The bound sits where every accept path, graph and eager, meets.
- The compact epilogue passes `scored_lens=verify_lens`. It also fills candidates past the cutoff with the real drafts from `draft_tokens_buf`, so the first draft past the cutoff is checked against its real value, as the eager path already does.
- The eager path passes `scored_lens` only when the worker ran compact verify. Cap-accept mode, where the rows past the cutoff are real, keeps its full multi-token counts.
- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dspark_accept_tail.py` gets a new `TestCompactAcceptTail` class:
  - explicit greedy cases (padding, a token-0 draft tail, early rejection, a genuine accept past the cutoff, cap-accept kept)
  - a captured CUDA graph replayed across 8 steps with changing drafts and cutoffs
  - a deterministic compact sampled-acceptance case
  - all checked against an independent oracle, including the block-accept buffer
- The file is now also registered for AMD CI.

## Accuracy Tests

- Generated tokens are unchanged by construction; the tests also check that `correct_len`, `bonus`, `commit_lens` and `out_tokens` are identical with and without the bound.
- The new tests fail on current `main` and pass with this change. They also fail on two deliberately broken fixes: one that bounds `AcceptOuts` but writes the unbounded value to the block-accept buffer, and one that wrongly bounds cap-accept mode.
- 44 tests pass across the DSpark unit suites. Tested on an **AMD MI355 (gfx950)** machine.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: one element-wise `torch.minimum` plus an in-graph copy; no change to verify or accept kernels.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation — N/A.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results — N/A (metrics-correctness fix).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+        dense_logits = torch.randn(bs * STRIDE, VOCAB)
+        dense_logits.scatter_(1, target_predict.view(-1, 1), 100.0)
+        cap_accept = self._eager(candidates, dense_logits, verify_lens, None)
+        self.assertEqual(cap_accept.cap_trim_lens.tolist()[3], 3)
+        self._assert_accept(cap_accept, candidates, target_predict, verify_lens, None)
+
+    def test_replayed_graph_reads_each_steps_drafts_and_cutoffs(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(1)
+        bs, num_rows = 4, 4 * STRIDE
+        epilogue = self._epilogue(bs)
+        compact_logits = torch.zeros(num_rows, VOCAB, device="cuda")
+        compact_ids = torch.zeros(num_rows, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+        call = dict(
+            compact_logits=compact_logits,
+            compact_hidden=torch.zeros(num_rows, 4, device="cuda"),
+            input_ids=compact_ids,
+            seq_lens=torch.arange(7, 7 + bs, device="cuda"),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(bs, device="cuda"),
+            bs=bs,
+        )
+
+        def load_step():
+            # A 3-token alphabet makes long matching chains and token-0 drafts common.
+            candidates = torch.randint(0, 3, (bs, STRIDE))
+            target_predict = torch.where(
+                torch.rand(bs, STRIDE) < 0.75,
+                torch.roll(candidates, -1, dims=1),
+                torch.randint(0, 3, (bs, STRIDE)),
+            )
+            verify_lens = torch.randint(1, STRIDE + 1, (bs,))
+            step_logits, step_ids, strided = _compact_verify_inputs(
+                candidates, target_predict, verify_lens, num_rows
+            )
+            compact_logits.copy_(step_logits)
+            compact_ids.copy_(step_ids)
+            epilogue.begin_step(verify_lens.cuda(), armed=False)
+            epilogue.draft_tokens_buf[: bs * (STRIDE - 1)].copy_(
+                candidates[:, 1:].reshape(-1)
+            )
+            return candidates, target_predict, verify_lens, strided
+
+        load_step()
+        side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+            epilogue(**call)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            epilogue(**call)
+
+        for step in range(8):
+            with self.subTest(step=step):
+                candidates, target_predict, verify_lens, strided = load_step()
+                graph.replay()
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                replayed = epilogue.read_accept(bs)
+                self._assert_accept(
+                    replayed, candidates, target_predict, verify_lens, verify_lens
+                )
+                self._assert_block_accept(
+                    epilogue, bs, candidates, target_predict, verify_lens
+                )
+                eager = self._eager(candidates, strided, verify_lens, verify_lens)
+                for field, value in msgspec.structs.asdict(eager).items():
+                    self.assertTrue(
+                        torch.equal(
+                            getattr(replayed, field).cpu().long(), value.cpu().long()
+                        ),
+                        field,
+                    )
+
+    def test_sampled_accept_bounds_only_the_trim(self):
+        """Rejection sampling also scans the padding rows: a zero row's softmax
+        equals a uniform draft's, so every padded draft is accepted. The scored
+        rows must bound that trim and leave the accept and bonus untouched."""
+        torch.manual_seed(2)
+        bs, gamma = 4, STRIDE - 1
+        verify_lens = torch.tensor([2, 3, 3, STRIDE], dtype=torch.int64)
+        candidates = torch.randint(1, VOCAB, (bs, STRIDE))
+        # One-hot scored rows (p ~ 1): rows 0, 1 and 3 accept every scored draft.
+        target_token = torch.roll(candidates, -1, dims=1)
+        # Row 2 rejects d1, so its bonus is the residual's only token.
+        target_token[2, 0] = candidates[2, 1] % (VOCAB - 1) + 1
+        logits = torch.zeros(bs * STRIDE, VOCAB)
+        for r in range(bs):
+            for w in range(int(verify_lens[r])):
+                logits[r * STRIDE + w, target_token[r, w]] = 100.0
+
+        def accept(scored_lens):
+            torch.manual_seed(3)
+            return self._eager_sampled(candidates, logits, verify_lens, scored_lens)
+
+        unbounded, bounded = accept(None), accept(verify_lens)
+        self.assertEqual(unbounded.cap_trim_lens.tolist(), [3, 2, 0, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(bounded.cap_trim_lens.tolist(), [1, 1, 0, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(bounded.correct_len.tolist(), [1, 2, 0, gamma])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            bounded.bonus.tolist(),
+            [
+                int(candidates[0, 2]),
+                int(candidates[1, 3]),
+                int(target_token[2, 0]),
+                int(target_token[3, gamma]),
+            ],
+        )
+        for field in ("correct_len", "bonus", "commit_lens", "out_tokens"):
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(getattr(bounded, field), getattr(unbounded, field)), field
+            )
+
+    def _eager_sampled(self, candidates, logits, verify_lens, scored_lens):
+        bs = candidates.shape[0]
+        return _eager_accept(
+            candidates=candidates.cuda(),
+            logits=logits.cuda(),
+            prefix_lens=torch.arange(7, 7 + bs, device="cuda"),
+            verify_lens=verify_lens.cuda(),
+            tp_sync=_RecordingTpSync(),
+            simulated_correct_len=None,
+            scored_lens=None if scored_lens is None else scored_lens.cuda(),
+            # Zero draft logits: q = 1 / VOCAB for every drafted token.
+            draft_logits=torch.zeros(bs, STRIDE - 1, VOCAB, device="cuda"),
+            sampling_info=GraphSamplingInfo(
+                temperatures=torch.ones(bs, 1, device="cuda")
+            ),
+        )
+
+
 class _NoSiteTpSync(_RecordingTpSync):
     def enabled(self, site):
         return False
